description: This file is a Java Spring MVC Controller class named OrderActionsControler. It handles various administrative order-related actions such as capturing payments, issuing refunds, printing invoices, listing transactions, sending invoices via email, updating order status, and sending download links. It interacts with multiple services including OrderService, CustomerService, PaymentService, etc., and manages HTTP requests for the admin ordering interface.

classes.name: OrderActionsControler
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing administrative order actions including capture, refund, invoice printing, transaction listing, email notifications, status updates, and downloads.

methods.name: captureOrder
methods.description: Handles capturing payment for an order given its ID, performs validation, and invokes paymentService to process the capture.

methods.name: refundOrder
methods.description: Processes a refund request for a specific order, validating amounts and invoking paymentService for the refund.

methods.name: printInvoice
methods.description: Generates and streams a PDF invoice for the specified order.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists transactions related to an order, returning details such as date, type, amount, etc.

methods.name: sendInvoice
methods.description: Sends the order invoice via email to the customer.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the order status and notifies the customer via email.

methods.name: sendDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends an email with a download link for the order.
